author: Leviticus30
quote: TBH i dont think this game is a 1 out of 10. more like a 5 or a 6. But i want this review to reflect the very poor writing and plotholes present throughout the game. Characters act completely opposite to who they are and have developed into throughout the first game. This is all because the writer decided that a specific scenario must happen even if it goes completely against what that character would have done. I could go on and on but there are other youtube reviews out there that im sure break this down much better than i could. Its so sad that these characters and this story were forced to push a narrative that only the director Neil Druckman wanted. such a letdown from the first game in so many ways. Graphics and gameplay are much improved and much more fluid. Enemy AI is absolutely TERRIBLE
game_title: The Last of Us Part II
